ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool mapping urban heat islands and canopy coverage in Baltimore to assist local municipal sustainability efforts.
ideas.title: Baltimore Urban Canopy & Heat-Island Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying satellite monitoring and geospatial data to localized industrial and environmental compliance.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness platform customized for Baltimore communities, mapping affordable healthy meal options and local food banks.
ideas.title: CharmCity Local Food & Nutrition Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact success of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant by tailoring personalized nutrition and health guidance into a polished web app.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered risk detection platform combining graph intelligence and anomaly detection to flag supply chain disruptions and suspicious transactions.
ideas.title: Port of Baltimore Supply Chain Risk & AML Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the technically rigorous pattern of Bito by building an AML and risk assessment platform focused on regional logistics.

ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics tool utilizing Poisson regression and rolling backtests to forecast campus safety incidents and optimize resource allocation.
ideas.title: UMBC Campus Incident & Safety Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements the hard statistical modeling seen in the ai-incident-forecasting winner using Poisson GAMs and calibrated prediction intervals.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace enabling Baltimore-based independent creators to sell goods with automated USDC escrow payments on Base.
ideas.title: Local Artist & Maker Autonomous Escrow Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning architecture of Dispatch by combining functional AI agents with Web3 escrow transactions.
